newsitem.title: CHINA: SOCCER-HONG KONG FANS SHUN MANCHESTER UNITED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HONG KONG FANS SHUN MANCHESTER UNITED.

text.p: Rain and the absence of Ryan Giggs and other top players have persuaded some Hong Kong fans that Manchester United's friendly match on Sunday is not worth attending.

Local side South China said on Saturday they had agreed to refund some fans for tickets to their friendly against the English champions after complaints that Giggs, David Beckham and Gary Neville would not be playing.
"Firstly it's raining and secondly the most famous players aren't even there," one unhappy fan told ATV television news.
Manchester United chairman Martin Edwards earlier told reporters that the 20-strong squad, which includes 15 internationals, was very strong.
United beat Thailand 2-0 in a friendly on Thursday at the start of their Asian tour and arrived in Hong Kong on Friday.
